Point 1. The August invoice carries a storage overage that is billed a month behind, so the line you are reading in August is the storage you used in July. The rate did not change, the volume did, and the two lines you asked about are the two days the export job ran twice after the failed run on the eleventh. I have attached the usage report for the period so the numbers can be checked against your own records, and I will hold the invoice open until you have confirmed it.
